env-app-sidebar.report: The sidebar is gone, with its toggle, its resize handle and its drawer: the navigation forms in a Scaffold's navigation have classes of their own, in the slots env-scaffold-bar, env-scaffold-rail and env-scaffold-drawer.

env-app-navigation.report: The sidebar is gone: the navigation forms, in a Scaffold's navigation, have classes of their own.

env-app-brand.report: The brand mark has no class of its own in 1.0: put it in a TopBar's start, and style your own element there.

env-app-context.report: The topbar's context has no class of its own in 1.0: it sits in a TopBar's start; style your own element there.

env-app-actions.report: The topbar's actions are env-top-bar-actions in 1.0, a TopBar's actions.

env-app-topbar-context.report: The split topbar is gone: the context sits in a TopBar's start.

env-app-topbar-page.report: The split topbar is gone: the title and actions are a TopBar's title and actions.

env-app-loading-bar.report: The page progress bar is a TopBar's loading, env-top-bar-loading-bar.

env-app-navigation-placeholder.report: AppShellSkeleton is gone: the navigation, with skeleton, stands in for itself over placeholders(count), with no class of its own.

env-app-shell-skeleton.report: AppShellSkeleton is gone: give the frame's parts skeleton, which marks each root with data-env-skeleton, and render them over placeholders(count).

env-app-toggle-icon.report: The sidebar toggle is gone: the Scaffold shows the navigation form that fits its width.

env-app-shell.report: AppShell is gone: its frame is a Scaffold, env-scaffold, whose data-compact, data-medium, data-expanded and data-large name the navigation form each window class shows, and nothing collapses; its header is a TopBar, env-top-bar, and its main region env-scaffold-body.

env-sidebar.report: Sidebar is gone, with its trigger, handle and groups: the navigation forms in a Scaffold's navigation, Bar, Rail and Drawer, have classes of their own, env-bar-*, env-rail-* and env-drawer-*, in the slots env-scaffold-bar, env-scaffold-rail and env-scaffold-drawer.
